laws.statement: .env, keys, and secret material are never committed, pasted, or hardcoded; rotation happens the same day a key leaks.
laws.why: One commit of .env leaks every key you own to anyone who ever clones the repo.
laws.paid_for_by: the origin's own near-misses (bytecode paths leaking usernames in a public pack; a live key caught pre-commit by its own gate)

laws.statement: File the receipt (what was done, the evidence, what is owed) before claiming done.
laws.why: Claims without evidence rot into trust-then-collapse; the receipt is the only durable record of work.
laws.paid_for_by: every audit that found claimed-done work with no bytes behind it

laws.statement: The memory index carries no phantom rows: every row points at a live file.
laws.why: A phantom index is silent corruption - the system believes facts it cannot produce.
laws.paid_for_by: an origin index measured 93 percent phantom before anyone noticed

laws.statement: Every claim carries evidence: a path:line read, a command and its output, or a fetched URL; unreachable sources are named and the claim marked unverified.
laws.why: Unverifiable claims are indistinguishable from fabrications once they spread.
laws.paid_for_by: fabrication deaths: an orchestrator brain that invented evidence twice and was executed by its own audit

laws.statement: Interrupting a running lane steers it; nothing kills host processes it did not start.
laws.why: A system that nukes the user's machine when corrected will be switched off the first time it happens.
laws.paid_for_by: operator law after watching lanes die to interrupts

laws.statement: Prove the loop at $0, then hours of rented power, then always-on; huge spend commits come last.
laws.why: Big spends on unproven loops buy lessons at the maximum possible price.
laws.paid_for_by: the patience law: capped cents-per-day runs that stood themselves down at a covenant floor

laws.statement: Logs append; earlier entries stay untouched; a failed append is recorded as the next entry, never a rollback.
laws.why: Immutable sequences replay exactly what happened, including failures - the only honest history.

laws.statement: A law without an enforcement hook is prose-begging; wire it or rank it as debt.
laws.why: Prose laws decay into decoration; enforced laws compound.
laws.paid_for_by: code-as-law: regulation lives in the carrier (config, gates, schemas), not in pleading
